answer: To raise the cost of fake swarms, each new agent must stake a refundable bond and complete a work-gated challenge that peers re-grade. Bonds sit in a crystal escrow until the agent proves sustained useful output across epochs; spam identities bleed capital while honest ones reclaim it. A lotus reputation graph then weights attestations by historical coherence, so a cold tundra of disposable accounts cannot outvote established miners without paying real compute and locked funds.
